name: Danny — everyone in his group is on a C, and his wing has never actually held him back
summary: Around 150 hours, 60 or so of them thermic, flying a couple of times a month on light to moderate days, two or three similar sites, a couple of short cross-countries by accident. New-ish to his current wing. Says plainly that the main reason he wants a C is that most of the people he flies with are on one, and that what he's working on this season is keeping up with them.
why_this_persona: The 'competent but aspirational' case, and the one the two combination gates are built for. Nothing about his flying is bad — he is mid-table on almost every skills question — but the two things the sources at this step are least shy about are both true of him: no evidence the wing has limited him, and a comparison-driven motive. He also sits deliberately just ABOVE the ambition gate's skills threshold, so that gate must stay silent and the two motive gates must do the work.

notes: Computed skills 59.2, psychological 57.5, total 58.4, no bonus. Above the Nearly ready floor of 55 on score, so without the gates he would read as Nearly ready — the gates are doing the work and the score is still shown.

TWO gates fire. 'aspirational_rather_than_demonstrated' needs 'the wing hasn't held me back' plus any one of a weak motive, thin skills or thin thermic hours; he satisfies it on the motive. 'equipment_as_a_fix_with_thin_readiness' needs a comparison or equipment-as-fix motive plus thin readiness; he satisfies it on the motive plus skills below 70. max_gate_reasons_shown is 3, so he sees both, and the gates array order puts them last — both read better arriving after the specific, actionable ones.

'ambition_without_readiness' must NOT fire, and the margin is deliberate: he ticks longer_xc, but his skills score sits a few points ABOVE that gate's 55 threshold. knowledge/disagreements.md point 9 requires ambition never to cost a band on its own, and this persona is the near-miss that proves the threshold is doing the filtering rather than the ambition tick.

'performance_chasing_reframe' must NOT fire either, for a different reason: his motive is comparison, not performance, so the right suggestion is 'motivation_reframe_keeping_up'. The two are deliberately separate suggestions with separate bodies — one is about the group, the other is about whether the glide is there to be had.

'site_variety_build' and 'xc_experience_build' both fire, and neither contributes to either gate. They cost him roughly five points of skills between them, which at this score is enough to notice and nowhere near enough to decide anything — which is exactly the 'supporting signal' treatment knowledge/disagreements.md points 5 and 14 ask for.
'launch_practice' must NOT fire — he answers 'nearly always clean in the conditions I choose' (0.75). Worth asserting so a reviewer doesn't read his Not yet as being about launches.

TONE CHECK: the gate messages must land as 'there's performance still in the wing you have' and 'work out what you're actually losing ground on', never as 'you want this for the wrong reasons'. docs/design-context.md's tone rule is binding here, and this is the persona most exposed to it.
